microsoft-1970393557050889.text: Develop and execute the global Chief Information Security Officer audience strategy, using insights into security leadership priorities, challenges, decision-making, and engagement preferences. Develop a connected audience journey across digital channels, executive programs, community engagement, industry events, and regional initiatives. Partner with Chief Security Advisors, sales, field marketing, and executive leadership to develop targeted engagement opportunities, including executive summits, advisory forums, roundtables, and individual executive discussions. Collaborate with Security thought leadership teams to develop relevant content addressing cybersecurity resilience, Artificial Intelligence security, data protection, threat defense, regulatory changes, security economics, and workforce transformation. Partner with Integrated Marketing, digital marketing, web, email, social media, and community teams to expand audience reach and support ongoing engagement. Gather and share insights from security leaders to inform messaging, thought leadership, product marketing, engineering, sales, and future audience strategies. Define and track audience engagement metrics, including audience growth, repeat engagement, relationship development, digital engagement, advocacy, and pipeline influence, to evaluate program effectiveness and inform improvements. Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, or related field AND 3+ years integrated marketing (e.g., digital, relationship, social media, campaign), event management, marketing strategy, business planning, marketing operations, or related work experience OR equivalent experience. Master's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, or related field AND 2+ years integrated marketing (e.g., digital, relationship, social media, campaign), event management, marketing strategy, business planning, marketing operations, or related experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, Public Relations, or related field AND 5+ years integrated marketing (e.g., digital, relationship, social media, campaign), event management, marketing strategy, business planning, marketing operations, or related experience OR equivalent experience. Experience working in cybersecurity, including hands-on technical experience in security architecture, security engineering, consulting, or technical product marketing. Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI), agentic systems, and related security considerations, including model and agent identity, data boundaries, prompt and tool abuse, and AI risk governance. Ability to translate complex security architecture concepts into clear, actionable guidance for technical practitioners. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product management, and Product Marketing Managers (PMMs). Experience in writing, content development, and editorial decision-making.

microsoft-1970393557048168.text: Implementing robust AI transformation solutions and optimizing the integration of various technologies and services will be key aspects of your role. Delivering customer engagements: Prepare and deliver technical engagements including strategy sessions, envisioning workshops, architecture design sessions and rapid prototyping to demonstrate key capabilities, validate against identified risks and finalize technology choices. AI Transformation Leadership: Be the trusted voice within the business and for customers on the latest AI platform and technology trends, guiding their transformation journeys. By prioritizing AI use cases through design thinking workshops, you will lead these journeys effectively. Strategic Vision and Planning: Own and execute a clear strategic vision for AI transformation initiatives on a set of targeted accounts, aligning with organizational goals and customer needs by collaborating and orchestrating cross-functional teams. Solution Design and Architecture: Develop comprehensive solution architectures based on patterns and practices that are tied to customer requirements and ensure that solutions are scalable, secure and optimized for performance. By utilizing consultation skills, you will uncover and prioritize opportunities, ensuing solutions are addressing real customer needs. Cross Platform Collaboration: Adopt a holistic approach to integrate capabilities across the entire cloud platform, identifying synergies and optimizing cross-platform integration. You will work with your peers and stakeholders to make the Innovation Hub the home of Cross Solution AI Transformation. Stay updated with the market trends and collaborate with the technical communities. Lead the creation of scalable, field-relevant assets through internal communities. Champion Hub engagement success by connecting technical capabilities to sales opportunities and serving as a trusted voice with sales leaders and account teams.
